text:
sara_support: alert from a customer — several accounts reporting 500s and timeouts hitting /v1/generate since ~14:22 UTC. multiple support tickets opened. pinging eng.
emma_infra: thanks, grabbing traces now. Do we have a rollout that started around then? :eyes:
deploy-bot: staged-release-started user=olivia_backend job=seed-release release_id=rel_2026_03_17_1420 rollout: weight=10% -> 25%
olivia_backend: that was my seed release to enable route_authorization_v2 for a subset of hosted routes. only targeted weight 10% initially.
raj_ops: telemetry shows 5xx rate jump at 14:23 across edge gateways. aggregated 5xx = +420% vs baseline. latency P95 also up.
luis_sre: sample gateway logs from 14:24: ``ERROR upstream_eof: upstream closed connection without sending headers``. Also seeing internal 500 with message `panic: missing customer-id header` from auth-proxy.
emma_infra: auth-proxy change in the feature toggles includes a transform that strips legacy headers and expects `x-customer-id` to be present. if not, it returns 500. That transform was part of the route_authorization_v2 flag.
olivia_backend: oh — we added a header rewrite that replaces `Authorization` with `authorization` and removes any `X-Deprecated-Customer` header. probably overzealous.
sara_support: customers reporting both 500s and sudden billing errors (quota checks failing). one customer says: "we're getting 500s and then invoice preview shows zero tokens billed" — likely downstream failure short-circuiting billing flow.
raj_ops: repro steps so far: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -> on canary hosts returns 500 \nlogs: ``auth-proxy: key lookup failed: missing x-customer-id``
emma_infra: hypothesis: the rewrite removed the header before the auth-checker runs. that causes a panic path in the auth-checker resulting in 500 instead of a 401. code path assumed header presence.
olivia_backend: my rollout config: ``flags: { route_authorization_v2: true } routing: { tag: "seed-2026-03" }`` — I didn't include the backward-compat shim for `x-customer-id` population. my bad.
luis_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause/rollback flag in release system 2) patch auth-proxy to defensive check and return 401 3) short-circuit the transform via config override at edge.
raj_ops: can we rollback the rollout to 0% now? deploy-bot: rollback request acknowledged for release_id=rel_2026_03_17_1420 -> target weight=0% initiating.
deploy-bot: rollback in progress: 25% -> 10% -> 0% (estimated 60s per step)
emma_infra: coordinating rollback. @olivia_backend stay on call to confirm your change is reverted. SRE, please watch error rate and let support know when safe to update customers.
luis_sre: monitoring endpoints: 5xx rate trending down after the rollback step to 10%. P95 latency still elevated on a few gateways — investigating backlog.
raj_ops: running a quick smoke: curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -> 200 from three canary IPs now.
sara_support: writing to affected customers: "We've identified a config rollout as the cause of increased 5xx; we've rolled back the change and are monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause and remediation ETA." :white_check_mark:
olivia_backend: taking full ownership. I'll open a PR to add defensive header checks and a safe-populate shim that honors `X-Deprecated-Customer` if present. Also will add unit+integration tests for header transforms.
emma_infra: postmortem checklist: capture timeline, list of releases and weights, reproduce, link to PR, add automated canary health gating for 5xx > 1% above baseline for >2 minutes to auto-pause.
luis_sre: post-rollback note: running sweep to reconcile any billing gaps — if requests were short-circuited before billing hook, we'll reconcile tokens and flag customers for credit if needed.
raj_ops: confirm last 10 minutes 5xx is back within baseline. will leave monitoring alert muted for 15m while we stabilize.
sara_support: thanks team. I'll update support tickets and let customers know we've begun reconciliation and will send a follow-up timeline.
olivia_backend: again sorry — will hold on further rollouts until fix is merged and tested. moving to triage. :bow:
deploy-bot: rollout complete: rel_2026_03_17_1420 weight=0% rollback=success duration=3m2s
